correctness.rationale: The exact character inversion gives each mixing eigenvalue as the number of ordered equal-energy pairs divided by 2n. Equal-layer congruence 2k=a gives the stated baseline spectrum. In the opposite-layer case x_k-x_l=2, where x_k=2cos(2pi k/n). Every conjugate of y=x_k-1 lies in [-1,1], so Kronecker integrality forces y=-1,0,1; only (0,-2),(1,-1),(2,0) survive. Counting their differences yields exactly two modes at 4|n and three at 6|n (disjoint at 12|n). All n>=3 and Fourier multiplicity-one indexing are covered. Independent direct pair-energy counts for all 3<=n<=24 verified all 594 Fourier labels and ranks. This finite check is not substituted for the algebraic proof.
